title: Prompt-to-Leaderboard
domain_tags: LLM evaluation | human preference modeling | model selection
task_tags: model ranking | preference prediction | query routing | model diagnostics
method_tags: Bradley-Terry regression | prompt-conditioned ranking | LLM-based evaluation routing
core_contributions: Introduces Prompt-to-Leaderboard (P2L), a method that generates prompt-specific leaderboards using LLMs to predict Bradley-Terry coefficients from natural language prompts. | Enables unsupervised, fine-grained evaluation without requiring prompt-stratified human voting data — overcoming data scarcity for niche tasks (e.g., SQL queries). | Demonstrates power-law scaling of prompt-specific evaluation capability with model size and data, and deploys a P2L-based router achieving #1 on Chatbot Arena in Jan 2025.

title: FR-Spec: Accelerating Large-Vocabulary Language Modelsvia Frequency-Ranked Speculative Sampling
domain_tags: natural language processing | LLM inference | speculative decoding
task_tags: machine translation | multi-turn conversation | retrieval-augmented generation | arithmetic reasoning | question answering | document summarization
method_tags: speculative sampling | vocabulary pruning | frequency-based filtering | draft-then-verify
core_contributions: Introduces FR-Spec, a frequency-ranked vocabulary compression strategy for speculative sampling to reduce LM head computation overhead by 75% | Demonstrates 1.12× average speedup over EAGLE-2 on large-vocabulary LLMs (e.g., Llama-3-8B with 128k tokens) | Provides a plug-and-play enhancement compatible with existing speculative sampling methods (e.g., EAGLE-2, Medusa) without retraining

title: Aligning LLMs to Ask Good QuestionsA Case Study in Clinical Reasoning
domain_tags: clinical reasoning | healthcare AI | medical NLP
task_tags: follow-up question generation | interactive diagnosis | uncertainty-aware questioning
method_tags: preference tuning | attribute decomposition | counterfactual perturbation | structured alignment
core_contributions: Introduces Alfa, a theory-grounded framework for aligning LLMs to ask high-quality follow-up questions via fine-grained attribute decomposition (e.g., clarity, diagnostic relevance, medical accuracy) | Releases MediQ-AskDocs: a new dataset of 17k clinical interactions and 80k expert-annotated, attribute-specific preference pairs for question-asking evaluation | Demonstrates 56.6% reduction in diagnostic errors and 64.4% question-level win-rate over SOTA instruction-tuned LLMs via preference-based alignment on clinical reasoning tasks
